_comment: Manually curated EMA / CHMP seed entries used as the last-good fallback by
biotech_sniper.calendar.ema when the live www.ema.europa.eu source is
unreachable (e.g. operator runs the CLI in a sandbox without outbound
network access, or the EMA site returns a transient 5xx). Each entry MUST
carry ticker_or_sponsor (uppercase ticker when known, otherwise sponsor
name), product, and at least one of meeting_date / opinion_date in
ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) form. source_url MUST be on host www.ema.europa.eu
These dates target a rolling 90-day window centered on the bundling
date and are refreshed by future operator runs. They are not guaranteed
to reflect the live EMA pipeline; the live scrape supersedes them
whenever it succeeds (UPSERT on the composite UNIQUE key:
